0.long_answer: The German physician known for his namesake syndrome – which has come to be referred to as balderdash syndrome – is Justinus Kerner. Kerner was not only a practicing doctor but also a poet whose 19th‐century writings, including his account in Die Seherin von Prevorst (1826), left a memorable impression. Over time, his unusual observations and descriptions became associated with a syndrome that, in a somewhat tongue-in-cheek fashion, bears his name.
